units.source_text: 内大臣又对乳母和侍女们说：“好了，不必再提了。

en.t: The Minister of the Interior again said to the nurse and the ladies-in-waiting, "Enough, there is no need to mention it anymore.

units.source_text: 你们暂时不可将此事泄露出去。

en.t: For the time being, you must not let this matter leak out.

units.source_text: 虽然对外终是瞒不过的，

en.t: Although in the end it cannot be hidden from the outside world,

units.source_text: 但你们听到时必须竭力辩解，说明决无此事。

en.t: when you hear people speak of it, you must do your utmost to deny it and say that there is absolutely no such thing.

units.source_text: 我即日就要叫小姐迁居到我私邸内。

en.t: I will have the young lady move into my private residence at once.
As for the old lady, I cannot help feeling resentment toward her.

units.source_text: 你们几个人呢，想来总不会希望有此种事情的吧。”

en.t: And as for you all, surely you could not have wished for such a thing to happen."

units.source_text: 侍女们知道他不怪她们，愁叹之中又感到欢喜，便讨好他：“我们当然不希望有此种事情！

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting realized that he did not blame them, and though still grieving, they felt relieved and tried to please him, saying, "Of course we did not wish for such a thing!

units.source_text: 我们还担心被大纳言老爷得知呢。

en.t: We were also worried that His Excellency the Major Counselor might find out.

units.source_text: 我们觉得夕雾少爷虽然品貌俱全，终究只是一个臣下，有什么可贵呢？”

en.t: We thought that although young Lord Yugiri has both talent and good looks, he is after all only a courtier, so what is so precious about him?"
